facts.text: Document type: formal State Building Code Council interpretation no. 16-07, one page; requester City of Cheney.
Code and section: 2015 IRC, R302.3 Two Family Dwellings.

A requester was asked to evaluate documentation for an alternative method of providing separation-wall continuity within the floor cavity between floors of multi-story two-family dwellings; joists run perpendicular to the wall.
The question says the documentation is attached, but the attachment in this record is the Council reply only; the applicant documentation is not reproduced in the PDF.

limitations: The PDF contains the Council answer on the same page; do not present it as applicant-side input without flagging leakage.
Interpretation, not a variance or approval of any building; SBCC interpretations are advisory.

The applicant documentation and the test report the answer relies on are not reproduced in the PDF; the SBCC listing says supporting documents are not posted online and must be requested from Council staff.
Edition as cited (2015 IRC); not checked against the Washington adoption in force.
